name: Sensed presence (right temporoparietal)
summary: Burst-firing field weighted to the right temporoparietal junction (CP6) and posterior temporal lobe (TP8), then both sides. Persinger & Healey 2002 reported more 'presences' with right or bilateral than left or sham stimulation; Murphy says it needs real silence.
source: Persinger & Healey 2002, J Nerv Ment Dis 190:533 ; Murphy-Balbin interview https://youtu.be/1uVjHmi51HM?t=1222
